title: DeathLimit
description: Introduces a system where players are banned after reaching a set number of deaths.
body:
A lightweight Paper plugin that tracks player PvP deaths, shows each player’s death count in the tab list, and automatically bans anyone who reaches the configured PvP death limit. Includes a 
```
/setdeaths <player> <count>
``` 
command
for admins to adjust a player’s death total.

**Important:** This rule only applies if the player is in combat against another player.
